Mother-to-be Samantha Ruth Prabhu marked her godh bharai ceremony by wearing a gold Kanjivaram saree paired with gold jewellery, showcasing rooted elegance at the traditional baby shower.

The ceremony honored the ’94 kalas of Devi and featured a brief explanation from Prabhu about the cultural significance of the Kalaa Aav ritual.

Multiple Indian media outlets, including The Times of India, NDTV, Rediff, The Indian Express and The Economic Times, reported on the event, emphasizing both the fashion choice and the ritual’s heritage.
